title: Assaulted by a Migrant - Then Her Government Did This | Thais d'Escufon
description:
Lane Kendall sits down with Thais d’Escufon to discuss the threat of speaking out against immigration in France. Foreigners are committing a disproportionate number of crimes in European countries. Facing fines and possible prison time, Thais has been called “a Trojan horse filled with racist ideas” for speaking out against the threat. Will the French finally stand up to the foreign invasion that has breached their borders?
